title: knitCompanion Counter Session Rows Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter rows_completed=*
| stats sum(rows_completed) as total_value, avg(rows_completed) as avg_value by pattern_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pattern name values by total and average rows completed across knitCompanion counter session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rows_completed` values for each knitCompanion counter session event and review total and average rows completed by pattern name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rows completed.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which pattern name shows the biggest rows completed numbers in your knitCompanion counter session data.
